Use <fillcolor=red><fontsize=14> kind Tags for fixing the style of virtual blocks
In above line "My name is" will remain fixed & firstname & lastname will be replaced by the end
1> font : Add name of font to apply on the text. font must be available in system. eg <font=Open Sans>
2> fontsize : Add size of the text you want to apply. eg <fontsize=20>
3> fillcolor : color you want to apply on text. eg <fillcolor=red>
4> fakebold : true/false to make text bold/normal. eg <fakebold=true>
5> italicangle : pass angle at which the text should be italic. eg <italicangle =- 15>
6> underline : true/false To make underline on text. eg <underline=true>
7> strokecolor : if underline option is true pass stroke color for the color of underline. eg <strokecolor=red>
Text : My name is <fillcolor=red>{| firstname|} & {| lastname|}<fillcolor=black>.
